exposure: intention to have a cesarean section
cohort: 6,335 pregnant women in late pregnancy were recruited from a tertiary women's and children's hospital in western China.
finding: 79.8% of participants reported mild to severe fear of childbirth in late pregnancy, with lower education, primiparity, no history of uterine scarring, natural conception, intention to have a cesarean section, high myopia, and urinary disease identified as significant risk factors for severe fear.
mod_finding: Intention to have a cesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for severe fear of childbirth.
